mapper.select: SELECT id, region_id, category_id, product_name, price, description, image_url FROM products WHERE id = #{productId}
SELECT id, region_id, category_id, product_name, price, description, image_url FROM products
SELECT id, region_id, category_id, product_name, price, description, image_url FROM products WHERE region_id = #{regionId}
SELECT id, region_id, category_id, product_name, price, description, image_url FROM products WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT id, region_id, category_id, product_name, price, description, image_url FROM products WHERE region_id = #{regionId} AND category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT p.id, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.region_id AS regionId, SUM(od.quantity) AS totalQuantity FROM products p INNER JOIN order_details od ON p.id = od.product_id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url, p.region_id ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.id, p.product_name AS productName, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.region_id AS regionId, COALESCE(SUM(od.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_details od ON p.id = od.product_id WHERE p.region_id = #{regionId} AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY p.id, p.product_name, p.price, p.image_url, p.region_id ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT 3;
